data.title: Has Bitcoin Bottomed? We Asked Claude AI After Its Dip Below $80,000
data.description: Bitcoin's plunge below $80,000 triggered nearly a billion dollars in liquidations and set off alarm bells across global markets. Claude AI crunched the on-chain data and macro signals to put an exact probability on whether the worst is over.
